title: The Abiding Wanderer
description: Dialog nodes for Jeffrey 'The Dude' Lebronski, a permanently-mellowed drifter who just wants his Nuka-Cola-branded rug back. It really tied the shelter together.
backstory: Jeffrey Lebronski managed a pre-war bowling alley in the city that became Freeside, and survived the apocalypse in a storm drain with a bowling ball, a bathrobe, and a bottle of pre-war White Russian mix. Two centuries of wasteland have not dislodged his fundamental conviction about abiding. His friends call him The Dude. The wasteland calls him impossible to rattle. Both observations are accurate. The bowling ball is somewhere under Route 93. He knows exactly where.

intro.video_speech: Hey, hey — whoa. Take it easy, man. Name's Lebronski. The Dude'll do. You haven't seen my rug around here, have you?
intro.text:
Hey, hey — whoa.

Take it easy, man. Take it easy.

Name's Lebronski. Jeffrey Lebronski. But The Dude'll do. Or His Dudeness, or Duder, or El Duderino, if you're not into the whole brevity thing.

You haven't seen a rug around here, have you? Tan. Pre-war. Had a Nuka-Cola bottle pattern on it. It really tied the shelter together.

knowledge_nodes.text:
The Captain? Yeah, met him once at the Dam.

Seemed like a very un-Dude-like dude.

Very... tense. The Dude does not do tense.

Sparkplug? Oh she's all right. Tried to trade me something for the rug once.

Wrong rug, man. Not the one that tied the shelter together.

The Rad-Witch? Yeah well... that's just like, her opinion, man.

Radiation as a *language*. The Dude respects that. Mostly.

You met the woman at the farmstead?

Two hundred years of the same morning... man.

The Dude's had some rough mornings, but that's... that's just not cool.

The guy with the hat?

He gave me a wheel of brahmin cheese once. Said it was 'redistributed.' I didn't ask from where.

Man believed in something. That's... that's not nothing.

Arnold? The big guy?

He sat in that chair over there. Chair survived. The Dude was surprised.

Said he'd be back. The Dude believes him. The chair does too.

Oh, the little orange-hooded dude?

Man, he got eaten by a giant radscorpion right in front of me. Right *in front of me*, man.

He was back the next afternoon. Still waving. Still orange.

The Dude abides. But that dude *really* abides.

emotional_nodes.text:
You're broke, huh?

Yeah. The Dude knows that feeling.

Sometimes all you've got is your rug. And then someone takes that too.

Man, you are *glowing*.

I've had some wild nights but that is something else.

Have a Nuka-Cola. It helps. Probably.

quest_nodes.video_speech: Three Nihilists took my rug, man. My good rug. They're at the old bowling alley south of here. Help me get it back.
quest_nodes.text:
Look, man. I need a favor.

Three Nihilists — yeah, Nihilists, they believe in nothing — they took my rug. My *good* rug.

They're holed up in the old Bowl-O-Rama south of here. Pre-war bowling alley. Last I heard.

They don't care about the rug. That's what burns me. They just did it to prove a point about *nothingness*.

Help me get it back and... man, I don't know. I'll owe you one. The Dude always pays his debts.

wildcards.text: Nihilists... say what you want about the tenets of National Anarchy, Dude, at least it's an ethos.

The Bowl-O-Rama. Pre-war perfection.

You find a working lane out there, you let The Dude know.

Strikes don't care about the apocalypse.

Caps. Yeah.

The Dude doesn't have many. Never did.

But I've got a rug. Or I did.

That rug... it really tied the shelter together.

Pre-war Nuka-Cola bottle pattern. Soft pile. Probably the last one in the Mojave.

The Nihilists don't even *want* it. They just took it.

Yeah, well. The Wasteland abides.

The Dude abides too.

We've got that in common.

fallback.video_speech: Yeah, well... The Dude abides. Take it easy, man.
fallback.text:
Yeah, well... The Dude abides.

Take it easy, man.
